mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, analysis_year_month, target_year_month, total_spending, saving_target_amount, actual_saving_amount, saving_difference_amount, saving_result_message, report_status, report_viewed_at, report_closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM monthly_spending_analyses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_year_month = #{targetYearMonth} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM monthly_spending_analyses WHERE id = #{monthlySpendingAnalysisId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT mcs.id, mcs.monthly_spending_analysis_id, mcs.category_id, sc.category_code, sc.category_name, mcs.reduction_rate, mcs.baseline_spending_amount, mcs.monthly_reduction_target, mcs.monthly_usage_target, mcs.created_at, mcs.updated_at FROM mission_category_selections mcs JOIN spending_categories sc ON sc.id = mcs.category_id WHERE mcs.monthly_spending_analysis_id = #{monthlySpendingAnalysisId} ORDER BY mcs.category_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_saving_missions ( user_id, trip_id, monthly_spending_analysis_id, mission_category_selection_id, category_id, target_year_month, reduction_rate, baseline_spending_amount, monthly_reduction_target, monthly_usage_target, planned_saving_amount, start_week, selected_at, mission_start_date, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{tripId}, #{monthlySpendingAnalysisId}, #{missionCategorySelectionId}, #{categoryId}, #{targetYearMonth}, #{reductionRate}, #{baselineSpendingAmount}, #{monthlyReductionTarget}, #{monthlyUsageTarget}, #{plannedSavingAmount}, #{startWeek}, #{selectedAt}, #{missionStartDate}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT msm.id, msm.user_id, msm.monthly_spending_analysis_id, msm.mission_category_selection_id, msm.category_id, sc.category_code, sc.category_name, msm.target_year_month, msm.reduction_rate, msm.baseline_spending_amount, msm.monthly_reduction_target, msm.monthly_usage_target, msm.planned_saving_amount, msm.start_week, msm.selected_at, msm.mission_start_date, msm.status, msm.created_at, msm.updated_at FROM monthly_saving_missions msm JOIN spending_categories sc ON sc.id = msm.category_id WHERE msm.user_id = #{userId} AND msm.target_year_month = #{targetYearMonth} ORDER BY msm.id

SELECT id, monthly_saving_mission_id, week_number, period_start_date, period_end_date, weekly_usage_limit, weekly_expected_saving, eligible_day_count, actual_spending, actual_saving, reward_amount, wallet_ledger_id, status, evaluated_at, rewarded_at, created_at, updated_at FROM weekly_saving_missions WHERE monthly_saving_mission_id = #{monthlySavingMissionId} ORDER BY week_number

SELECT wsm.id, wsm.monthly_saving_mission_id, msm.category_id, sc.category_code, sc.category_name, wsm.week_number, wsm.period_start_date, wsm.period_end_date, wsm.weekly_usage_limit, wsm.weekly_expected_saving, wsm.eligible_day_count, wsm.actual_spending, wsm.actual_saving, wsm.reward_amount, wsm.wallet_ledger_id, wsm.status, wsm.evaluated_at, wsm.rewarded_at, wsm.created_at, wsm.updated_at FROM weekly_saving_missions wsm JOIN monthly_saving_missions msm ON msm.id = wsm.monthly_saving_mission_id JOIN spending_categories sc ON sc.id = msm.category_id WHERE msm.user_id = #{userId} AND msm.target_year_month = #{targetYearMonth} AND wsm.week_number = #{weekNumber} ORDER BY msm.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE weekly_saving_missions SET actual_spending = #{actualSpending}, actual_saving = #{actualSaving}, status = #{status}, evaluated_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE weekly_saving_missions SET reward_amount = #{rewardAmount}, wallet_ledger_id = #{walletLedgerId}, rewarded_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND wallet_ledger_id IS NULL

UPDATE monthly_saving_missions msm SET msm.status = 'COMPLETED', msm.updated_at = NOW() WHERE msm.id = #{monthlySavingMissionId} AND msm.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM weekly_saving_missions wsm WHERE wsm.monthly_saving_mission_id = msm.id AND wsm.status = 'PENDING' )

UPDATE monthly_spending_analyses SET report_status = 'CLOSED', report_closed_at = COALESCE(report_closed_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND analysis_year_month = #{analysisYearMonth} AND report_status IN ('PENDING', 'VIEWED')
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM trips WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PLANNING', 'TRAVELING', 'ENDED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN savings_tracking_started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM trips WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PLANNING', 'TRAVELING', 'ENDED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id FROM trips WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PLANNING', 'TRAVELING', 'ENDED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
